title: 棱镜折叠 / Prism fold
author: Rhythm Master
license_status: First-party composition using existing attributed operators; outbound license pending

descriptions.en-US: Fold your texture into a rotating prism. Bass and high bands steer opposite turns; the preview stripes are not inserted.
descriptions.zh-CN: 把输入纹理折叠成旋转棱镜。低频与高频驱动相反方向的转动，预览条纹不会插入工程。
